blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — A tropical depression being monitored outside the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) is not expected to directly affect the country or make landfall, the state weather bureau said Tuesday, September 15. As of 3 a.m. Tuesday, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) located the tropical depression 2,675 kilometers east of Eastern Visayas. The system was moving north-northwestward at 15 kilometers per hour (kph), with maximum sustained winds of 55 kph near the center and gusts of up to 75 kph.
